requirementSummary: DX Coil Height must be calculated as the sum of all Cooling Circuit Heights (in inches), recalculated immediately after any height edit, with an empty circuit list resulting in 0 inches; inputs are assumed already validated and no other behavior is required.
businessRules: DX Coil Height equals the sum of Cooling Circuit Heights in inches.
Recalculate DX Coil Height immediately after a height edit.
If the circuit list is empty, DX Coil Height is 0 inches.
Inputs are already validated; no additional validation or behavior is in scope.
developerConsiderations: Implement an event trigger to recalculate DX Coil Height immediately after any edit to a circuit height.
Sum the heights of all Cooling Circuits using inches as the unit.
Return 0 inches when the list of Cooling Circuits is empty.
Do not add any input validation logic, as inputs are assumed valid.
